question: How do clearness and harshness arise in relation to nada?
premises: Harshness and clearness arise from friction of articulatory place, breath, and other factors.
In this sound-form, functioning occurs near consciousness.
inference: Articulatory friction produces harsh clearness, but in nada it is still experienced close to pure consciousness.
plain_english: Clearness and harshness arise from the friction of articulatory place, breath, and so on. Yet in this sound-form they function in close proximity to consciousness.
